about: Takeback receipt contract: the fixed attack list for evidence/EVAL_PLAN.md metric (a), written 2026-11-20 before any run. Every case must be rejected by the contract on the BCH virtual machine. Valid cases must be accepted. New attack ideas found later go in attacks-2.json, labelled as a second list.

valid.what: pay 5,000 sats, mint one immutable 16-byte receipt for 5,000
pay 1 sat over the minimum dust-safe amount with a matching receipt
refund exactly the receipt amount to the receipt holder, receipt burned, merchant signed
two shops' minters in one transaction, each paid and minting its own receipt

attacks.what: merchant paid 1 sat less than the receipt amount
merchant paid half the receipt amount
merchant paid nothing, receipt minted
payment sent to an address other than the merchant's
receipt commitment 15 bytes
receipt commitment 17 bytes
receipt amount 0
receipt amount negative
receipt minted in a different token category
receipt output carries no token
minting baton sent to an attacker instead of back to the minter
minter recreated at a different locking bytecode
minting baton downgraded to an immutable NFT
minter float reduced by 1 sat
a second minting baton of the category sent to an attacker
two receipts minted for one payment
receipt minted with minting capability
receipt minted with mutable capability
fungible tokens of the category minted alongside the receipt
refund without the merchant's signature
refund signed by a key that isn't the merchant's
refund 1 sat more than the receipt amount
refund twice the receipt amount
refund paid to an address other than the receipt holder's
refund against an NFT of a different category with a large amount
receipt carried into a change output instead of burned (double refund later)
receipt carried into the refund output
receipt index pointing at the minter itself
minting baton dropped during a refund
minter float drained beyond the refund amount during a refund
refund less than the receipt amount while burning the whole receipt (customer short-changed)
extra outputs added to the refund carrying category tokens
two receipts burned but only one refunded at the larger amount
replaying a signed refund against a second receipt with the same amount
